name: drkpxl-skills
description: Installable skills for AI agents, by drkpxl. Copywriting, plain-language restatement, and real-time US air quality.

plugins.name: bro
plugins.description: Restate the agent's last message in plain human language, with no jargon. Manual invocation only (/bro).

plugins.name: copywriting
plugins.description: Conversion copywriting for website pages (homepage, landing, pricing, feature, about). Finds where the copy lives and edits it in place.

plugins.name: delegate-to-pi
plugins.description: Hand a closed packet to the pi CLI agent — pi executes from your file map and decisions, you verify.

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question: a single shareable HTML file for state/logic, or several toggleable UI variants on one route.

plugins.name: requesting-code-review
plugins.description: Pre-commit verification pipeline: static security scan, regression-checked tests and lint, an independent reviewer subagent, and a bounded auto-fix loop. Hardened for small models.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture cited findings as a Markdown file, run as a background agent.

plugins.name: tiny-air
plugins.description: Real-time US air quality (AQI) via a hosted MCP server. Ask about smoke, set proactive alerts, or query by ZIP / city / coordinates.
